events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.

events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.

events.info: Yuridia is the reigning queen of regional Mexican music. A powerhouse vocalist, a history-maker, and the artist your favorite artists look up to. From her record-breaking debut La Voz de un Ángel to selling out Mexico City's Plaza de Toros as the first woman ever to do so, she's spent two decades turning heartbreak into anthems. With her Diamond-certified hit "Qué Agonía," her Premio Lo Nuestro Album of the Year-winning Sin Llorar, and a string of 2026 singles building toward her next era, Yuridia doesn't just perform ? she makes you feel every word. Now she's bringing that voice to Fresno. Don't miss your chance to sing every lyric at the top of your lungs.

events.info: Get ready for the event that will change everything you thought you knew about freestyle - Monster Jam Freestyle Mania, presented by Spin Master. Monster Jam® trucks team up with Freestyle Motocross bikes to deliver gravity-defying skills and thrills. We've created one-of-a-kind FMX bikes for this epic team competition, each with the bold, iconic look of your favorite Monster Jam trucks, like the legendary Grave Digger®, El Toro Loco®, Sparkle Smash and more. Cheer for your favorite team as they pull off stunts you've never seen before. The energy, the action, the next-level thrills will keep you on the edge of your seat. It's a high-energy good time and it's only at Monster Jam.

We've created one-of-a-kind FMX bikes for this epic team competition, each with the bold, iconic look of your favorite Monster Jam trucks, like the legendary Grave Digger®, El Toro Loco®, Sparkle Smash and more. Cheer for your favorite team as they pull off stunts you've never seen before. The energy, the action, the next-level thrills will keep you on the edge of your seat. It's a high-energy good time and it's only at Monster Jam.
events.pleaseNote: -All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. -No costumes for guests 14 & older. -Please monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. -All tickets are subject to availability. -Prices & Competitors are subject to change. -Monster Jam Trackside begins approximately one hour before the event start time and features: o Competition Preview o Driver Interviews o Behind the Scenes with the Pit Crew o Judges Zone Overview o Opening Ceremonies o Giveaways o Power Rush Truck Introductions There's no better way to get ready for the action, so get to your seats early to experience all the family fun. -Visit MonsterJam.com for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions.
